title: ImmutableTraits
_note: Strict structured outputs require EVERY property to be listed in 'required' (the API rejects the schema otherwise: "'required' ... to be an array including every key in properties"). Fields that are conceptually optional are therefore required-but-emptyable: return [] rather than omitting them.

product_visual_traits.description: Short concrete appearance phrases that must survive every round, e.g. 'black-and-silver body', 'top control panel with touch buttons', 'black locking bar'. Describe only what is visible on the product itself: body colour and material, silhouette, panel/controls, distinctive hardware, proportions. Each entry 2-6 words, lowercase, no marketing language, no scene or background, no claims about performance.

accessories.description: Included accessories actually visible in the supplied images, e.g. 'stack of clear vacuum sealer bags'. Empty array if none are visible. Never guess at accessories that are not shown.

native_product_text.description: Text physically printed or silkscreened on the product body, exactly as legible, e.g. 'VACUUM SEALER', 'PULSE', 'SEAL'. This text is exempt from the marketing copy whitelist. Only include text you can actually read.
